experiment: V9 — configuration-only reasoning-effort experiment at BUILD
baseline_note: Merged V8 reasoning-effort seam (PR #53, head cc958c1). No code changes for V9 — configuration only.
sole_intervention: full-build/build reasoning effort changes from model default (max, no reasoning key sent) to explicit "low". BUILD completion budget unchanged at 16384 (the V8 sentinel is retained by design: 3/3 A-class observations under default reasoning exist at this exact ceiling). DESIGN, PLAN, TEST, routing, prompts, E21/E23, V3 structural repair, V4 continuation, empty-output behavior, budgets, and every other mechanism are frozen unchanged from V8.

mechanical_proof.harness: AgentRunner resolving the real evidence/v9-frozen-config/settings.json from a live .sle/settings.json
assertions: design: max_tokens=32768, no reasoning effort (undefined) — PASS
plan:   max_tokens=32768, no reasoning effort (undefined) — PASS
mechanical_proof.outbound_mapping_proof: tests/v8-reasoning-preflight.test.ts (node:test) 8/8 PASS at this baseline: declared effort is sent as reasoning:{effort}; undeclared steps carry NO reasoning key (byte-identical legacy body); whole-map fail-closed parsing; precedence; single-turn fail-closed guard.

hypotheses.claim: The BUILD A-class (zero visible output, reasoning exhaustion at the 16,384 ceiling under default/max reasoning — observed 3/3 in V8 at 495 kB-1.23 MB hidden reasoning) is caused by unbounded hidden reasoning consumption. Under reasoning effort=low, BUILD hidden reasoning stays far below the ceiling (predicted order 100 kB, consistent with TEST under low: 73-324 kB vs 1.09-1.23 MB under default), and BUILD clears the stage (validator PASS / workflow advances past build) in at least 2 of 3 treatment opportunities.
hypotheses.falsified_if: BUILD reaches finish=length with zero visible output (A-class signature) in any treatment opportunity, or clears fewer than 2 of 3.

hypotheses.claim: The A-class persists at BUILD even under effort=low — the stage's reasoning demand is structural (the build step requires more planning than low effort permits), and reasoning still consumes the entire 16,384 allowance with zero visible output.
hypotheses.falsified_if: No A-class signature occurs in any BUILD treatment opportunity.

hypotheses.claim: BUILD fails under effort=low but with a different failure signature: near-empty terminal output, marker corruption, validator FAIL with non-trivial output present, or another non-exhaustion class.
hypotheses.falsified_if: All BUILD treatment opportunities either clear or produce the A-class signature exactly.

hypotheses.claim: At least one workflow in this block completes BUILD and passes Gate B end-to-end (workflow terminal state success) — the campaign's first complete run under the frozen authority.
hypotheses.falsified_if: Zero workflows reach a successful terminal state in the block.

sampling_rule: Run until 3 evaluable BUILD treatment opportunities or 9 evaluable workflows, whichever occurs first. A treatment opportunity is an evaluable workflow that reaches the build step (treatment delivered, outcome observed regardless of result). Ordinary upstream failures (scoping/design/plan/test) consume workflow slots only. Transport-censored executions consume neither counter and are re-run. Any implementation, evidence, or procedure defect stops the block immediately.
reporting_requirements: workflow denominator: N evaluable workflows; BUILD reached X/N
end-to-end successes: E (workflows completing build with Gate B PASS)
continuation_rule: Frozen V4 semantics unchanged: continuation fires only at turn == threshold+1 with max_tokens stop, NON-EMPTY visible text, no tool use, and unspent continuation budget. Zero-text exhaustion is never continuable.
no_censoring_rule_required: V9 has no provider-ignore confound to control (V8 removed it); transport-censored executions are simply non-evaluable and re-run without consuming counters.
constraint: No tuning between runs. No mechanism changes. No V10 preregistration until this block closes and the operator reviews the evidence.
block_disposition: At rule termination: journal all runs, report both denominators plus end-to-end count, freeze the block record, and STOP for operator block review.
